test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Without the greenhouse effect, Earths temperature would be below freezing.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1: **Earths temperature would'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses an incorrect form of the noun **'Earth'. **
 
• **It should** be** 'Earth's'** rather than 'Earths' as the phrase 'Earths temperature' signifies temperature belonging to the Earth, demanding possessive form 'Earth's'.
 
• **The erroneous part** of the sentence, "Earths temperature would," should instead be "Earth's temperature would."
 
• This corrected sentence effectively communicates the possible condition if there was no greenhouse effect.

The **corrected sentence** reads: *"Without the greenhouse effect, Earth's temperature would be below freezing."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 **'be below freezing.' is correct as it stands and does not require any modification. The phrase denotes the state of temperature without the greenhouse effect.
 
• **Option 3** 'Without the greenhouse effect,' is also grammatically correct, emphasizing the situation in the absence of the greenhouse effect.
